title: Anthropic’s $23 billion loss sits beside $895 billion in leases
teaser: Anthropic’s revenue grew 12-fold, but the company reported a $23 billion loss. It says $5 billion went to short-term computing capacity it had reserved in advance, and another $2 billion to a program that matches employee donations. The scale of the loss matters alongside the company’s obligations: its updated prospectus puts leases for computing capacity and data centers at $895 billion, a commitment that looms over a possible IPO.
